_comment: Turkish public holidays (resmi tatil) for the winter 2026-27 ferry timetable, which runs the Sunday timetable on them (PDF p. 38: "RESMİ TATİL GÜNLERİNDE PAZAR TARİFESİ UYGULANIR"). Fixed national holidays: Law 2429 (Ulusal Bayram ve Genel Tatiller Hakkında Kanun), dates cross-checked on tr/en Wikipedia 'Türkiye'deki resmî tatiller' / 'Public holidays in Turkey' (mevzuat.gov.tr itself didn't load from our runners). Religious holidays: Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı's own calendar (namazvakitleri.diyanet.gov.tr/tr-TR/dinigunler, yearly table with Hijri dates): Ramazan Bayramı = 1–3 Şevval 1448, Kurban Bayramı = 10–13 Zilhicce 1448. Half days (arife, 28 Oct afternoon) are listed but not applied: the timetable doesn't say what runs on them, so the normal timetable applies. Fetched 2026-10-11. Extend `days` and `covers` with the next timetable.

days.2027-05-19: Kurban Bayramı (4. gün) · Atatürk'ü Anma, Gençlik ve Spor Bayramı

sources: Law 2429 Ulusal Bayram ve Genel Tatiller Hakkında Kanun (fixed dates), via https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Türkiye'deki_resmî_tatiller and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_holidays_in_Turkey
